items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: The interviewee discusses Miles Davis playing with Parker ('He was about 18 to 19 years old... when he was playing with Parker') but does not state that he himself played with, met, or had a direct personal relationship with Parker.

ctx.x: He got a lot of interest.

Yeah, yeah. Well, all those guys got a lot of interest. Parker, look, he helped them. I don't care what they said. They helped him, maybe, too. But you know how old Miles was playing with Parker? Yeah. He was just a child.
He was about 18 to 19 years old.
